principios.title: Few things, well chosen
principios.q: We don't pack your day with visits. We choose what is truly worth your time.

principios.title: We tell you the story
principios.q: Behind every stone, every dish and every weave there's a story. We tell it to you.

principios.title: We introduce you to its people
principios.q: Behind every experience there's a person with a name.

principios.title: You take part, you don't just watch
principios.q: You taste, you ask, you take part. You live it with your own hands, not through a bus window.

principios.title: We build it for you
principios.q: Your pace, your tastes and your dates. Every trip adapts to you.

principios.title: Before, during and after
principios.q: We're with you from the moment you dream of the trip until you're back home.

condiciones.title: It has a name
condiciones.body: You meet the person and their story. It's never a show for tourists.

condiciones.title: You do something
condiciones.body: You cook, weave, sow. You take part, you don't just watch.

condiciones.title: It can't be bought separately
condiciones.body: It's not on any booking website. You only live it within your trip.

condiciones.title: You take something home
condiciones.body: A recipe, a technique, a word in Quechua. And a friendship.

dias.body: You arrive in Lima and start with its food: twelve Peruvian bites in the historic center.
The Ballestas Islands in the morning, a pisco vineyard at midday and the Huacachina dunes at sunset.
You fly to the White City. At 2,335 m your body starts getting to know the altitude, effortlessly.
You cross the Andes to the Colca and end the day in hot springs.
You watch the Andean condor fly and continue to Puno, on the shores of Titicaca.
The Uros islands and Amantaní, where you have dinner and sleep in a family's home.
Taquile Island and, at night, a bus to Cusco.
You reach Cusco when your body already knows the altitude. Private tour of the Inca capital.
Maras, Moray, Chinchero and Ollantaytambo. In the afternoon, train to Aguas Calientes.
Machu Picchu with a private guide and return to Cusco.
Hike to Rainbow Mountain, above 5,000 m. At night, bus to Puerto Maldonado.
You sail the Tambopata River to the lodge and go out at night to look for monkeys and caimans.
At dawn, parrots and macaws at the Chuncho clay lick.
Last morning in the jungle and back by boat for your flight.

fases.title: All set before you fly
fases.body: The story of the places you're going to see, your first words in Quechua and who is going to welcome you.

fases.title: Always by your side
fases.body: A Travel Advisor looking out for you, a plan designed for the altitude and an itinerary that adapts to how you feel.

fases.title: Your travel journal
fases.body: What you lived and the names of those who made it possible, so the friendship stays alive.

pasos.title: Choose how you want to experience Peru
pasos.body: Are you into history, food or meeting people? Tell us what moves you and we'll build the trip from there, not from a catalog.

pasos.title: We design it with you
pasos.body: A Travel Advisor builds your tailor-made trip, with clear prices and altitudes from day one.

pasos.title: We're with you all the way
pasos.body: Before you fly, during every day of the trip and after you're back home.
